verdict.rationale: Crossplane has substantial public documentation, so offering an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. The pack shows no llms.txt, markdown-for-agents, or AI-targeted docs entry point. Marketing lines about APIs that 'AI systems can safely act on' and 'machine-readable' intent describe the product's declarative APIs, not agent-consumable documentation, so they are adjacent claims and earn no credit.
